conventions.current_source_note: REGCA supplies filtered dq current commands. No switching bridge, inner PWM loop, DC link, or explicit converter-side R-L state is used in TX3-GFL-0.1.
conventions.route_b_note: The ANDES REGCP1/REECB1 composition already uses instantaneous terminal vd in Ip=Pord/vd. The ParaEMT TX3 realization changes only the public update's voltage source and active-current denominator from filtered measurements to instantaneous terminal magnitude. This removes two nonstandard unmatched measurement poles while retaining the public REGCA/REECB/REPCA states.

derived_nominal.selection_note: Frozen pre-E03 weak-grid nominal from the standard second-order PLL bandwidth relationship; not calibrated to a target externality.

repca.plant_q_pi_note: Disabled for matched TX3 nominal operation because the public ParaEMT monitored-branch path is not implemented. Reactive control remains in REECB.

post_gfl_equilibrium.note: ANDES requires a StaticGen record as the REGCP1 initialization container. At converted buses its PV voltage equation is disabled and its reactive equation is fixed at the registered Q target; it is not a retained synchronous machine or voltage controller. The post-settle ParaEMT operating point supplies the remaining PV targets and constant-impedance load powers used by the matched ANDES linearization case.

background_dynamic_readiness.decision_rule: G2B passes only when all synchronous machines pass initialization, synchronism, final-window stationarity, inactive-limit, finite-state, and three-timestep convergence checks. GFL cases cannot advance when G2B fails.

provenance.paraemt_tx3_route_b_patch: numba_updateXibr uses instantaneous abc terminal magnitude for Vm and V3; see the TX3-GFL comments at those two equations.
provenance.note: Values are frozen before E03. Adjustments are allowed only when a documented unit, sign, base, or representation mismatch is demonstrated.
